+% ==========================================

+% title: Hyphenation patterns for American English
+% copyright: Copyright (C) 1990, 2004, 2005 Gerard D.C. Kuiken
+% notice: This file is part of the hyph-utf8 package.
+%     See http://www.hyphenation.org/tex for more information.
+% language:

+%         notice and this notice are preserved.
+% hyphenmins:

+%         right: 3
+% changes:
+%     March 1, 1990 Initial release
+%     May 30, 2005 Added copyright notice, no patterns change.
+% texlive:
+%     encoding: ascii
+%     babelname: usenglishmax
+%     legacy_patterns: ushyphmax.tex
+%     message: Hyphenation patterns for American English
+%     package: english
+% known_bugs:
+%     de-mo-c-rat: 'instead of dem-o-crat (see GitHub issue #15)'
+% ==========================================
+%
+% ushyphmax.tex -- patterns for more hyphenation pattern memory (12000+).
+% Also known as ushyphen.max.
+%
+% Needs extended pattern memory.
+% Hyphenation trie becomes 7283 with 377 ops.
+%
+% These patterns are based on the Hyphenation Exception Log
+% published in TUGboat, Volume 10 (1989), No. 3, pp. 337-341,
+% and a large number of incorrectly hyphenated words not yet published.
+% If added to Liang's before the closing bracket } of \patterns,
+% the patterns run errorfree as far as known at this moment.
+%
+% These patterns find all admissible hyphens of the words in
+% the Exception Log.  ushyph2.tex is a smaller set.
+%
+% Please send bugs or suggestions to tex-live (at) tug.org.
+%
+% 2005-05-30 (karl): in the past, ushyphmax.tex was a file containing
+% only the additional patterns, without the \patterns command, etc.
+% This turned out not to be very useful, since in practice the TeX
+% distributions need one self-contained file for a language.  Therefore,
+% ushyphmax.tex now contains both the additional patterns from
+% Dr. Kuiken, and the original patterns and hyphenations from Knuth's
+% hyphen.tex.
+%
+% The Plain TeX hyphenation tables.

 #!/usr/bin/env python3

+"""Reproduce the English Dart patterns and original notices, without network I/O."""

     'en-US': ('f4ffcd96c5cbc886bdad23f95dcae8edc3cd3620eae62f7946eceda97c4e68f8', 4938, 14),
     'en-GB': ('e95bb4ab350f620c41c231c4785d7bdb4f91949d3e631b30e08b3ead3c340a52', 8527, 8),
 }
+NOTICES = {
+    'en-US': 'ENGLISH_US_LICENSE',
+    'en-GB': 'ENGLISH_GB_LICENSE',
+}
 
 
-def generate(entry):
+def pinned_source(entry):
     raw = (ROOT / 'third_party/hyphenation' / entry['source']).read_bytes()
-    digest, pattern_count, exception_count = PINNED[entry['language']]
+    digest = PINNED[entry['language']][0]
     if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != digest or entry['source_sha256'] != digest:
         raise ValueError('Unreviewed source; inspect the original license and provenance first')
+    return raw
+
+
+def original_notice(entry):
+    # Keep every byte before the pattern section, including original TeX
+    # comments, copyright, permission, provenance and word-list restrictions.
+    # Hosts can bundle these small files without shipping the pattern sources.
+    preface, marker, _ = pinned_source(entry).partition(b'\\patterns{')
+    if not marker or not preface:
+        raise ValueError('Missing original source preface')
+    return preface
+
+
+def generate(entry):
+    raw = pinned_source(entry)
+    _, pattern_count, exception_count = PINNED[entry['language']]
     source = raw.decode('utf-8')
     clean = re.sub(r'%[^\n]*', '', source)
     pattern_blocks = re.findall(r'\\patterns\{([^}]*)\}', clean)
@@ -69,17 +89,22 @@ def main():
     for entry in manifest['inputs']:

-        if args.check:

+        notice = original_notice(entry)
